sets.title: Concerts
sets.blurb: Small rooms, big lights. Stage color pushed through Portra 800, and T-MAX 3200 when the room gets too dark to care about grain. Plus a band that set up by the lake in Central Park one afternoon.

sets.title: Travel
sets.blurb: Out West mostly: Garden of the Gods, Red Rocks, the Tetons in October, a dog by every river. Then a detour through London and Ghent.

sets.title: New York City
sets.blurb: Citi Field, Coney Island, the Manhattan Bridge at golden hour, the elevated tracks in Queens. Ultra Max 400 because the city already has enough contrast.

sets.title: Worn on Tour
sets.blurb: Walking up to strangers around New York City who are wearing great band merch and asking to take their picture. Awkward every time. Worth it every time.

sets.title: Sports
sets.blurb: Knicks fans in the street during the playoff run, and Argentina supporters turning a stadium parking lot into a party. Shot digital, because you cannot ask a crowd to hold still for film.
